note: Machine-written eval manifest, not a hand-edited rule/config file (same exception as .clearfelt/baseline.json under CLAUDE.md's JSON rule). Each entry names a fixture, a human label (ai or human), and the score band a well-calibrated detector should land in. scripts/eval.mjs reports the pass rate; a low rate is a real finding about detection recall, not something to fix by loosening the bands. `bucket` (added on ai-6/human-6 onward) is a self-labeled content-type tag (support, executive, sensitive, ...), not a multi-reviewer-panel label; see docs/decisions/0012 and the v0.3 plan's Phase 5 for why a full benchmark corpus with independent human ratings is deliberately out of scope for now.
